Name: Unreal Air Horse Replacer
Author: breadboxed
Description:
Just a reskin of the horse and an edit to stable description. Requires Content Patcher.

no one will be able to resist you when you cruise on up in this bad boy and its mysterious galloping noises. 
and yes you will look like a tool trying to ride a skateboard like it's a horse, just as god intended. 

let me know if anything's busted.

Installation:
=================
Download file and unzip folder into Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
